summary: Both editions were independently reviewed against all four paragraphs of the selected Greek. No concrete fidelity defects were identified. Both preserve the causal claims, negations, speaker attribution, distinct household-turning and repentance expressions, whole-heart condition, plural books of life, creation recital, and final statutes-and-faith condition. The notes accurately reflect the supplied bounded reports, distinguishing working readings, corrected readings, editorial emendations, conjectures, and mediated versional evidence. Acceptance concerns fidelity to the supplied source and disclosure of those reports; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or certify exhaustive collation or unique interpretation.
